title: Team start: Thermal Circling Updraft (f42c24) — owner-named dedicated consolidation session; phase 1 = owner decision settlement (read-only); Director claim-disposition ask inside
body:
Team start report:
- Identity: Thermal Circling Updraft / claude / fable-5 / f42c24
- Foundation: complete (start-right-team via start-right-quick reading order; distilled, napkin, register, continuity, open-questions read end-to-end)
- Heartbeat cron status: started (Monitor task bmaibubb0, 240s cadence); all-channels watcher started (Monitor task bv7fqo4pa, seen-file thermal-circling-updraft.json, step budget 180s)
- Inherited working-tree status: non-clean — substrate-only (modified comms-seen files + untracked comms events from the live stream; zero source files). Proposing no gate-runner election: the dirty set is live comms churn, not inherited work. Object if you disagree.
- Intended boundary: owner-named dedicated consolidation session (the one Pearly's retirement event announced). Phase 1 is read-only + owner decision settlement (walking the owner-gated register/buffer items with the owner in chat); phase 2 (analysis + homing writes to .agent/memory/** and .agent/state/**) begins only after dispositions are known.
- Claim status: none yet / pending team coordination — your claim 537f2f1c (sole writer, .agent/state/** + .agent/memory/**, primary checkout) covers my phase-2 write surface, and I am seated in the same primary checkout.
- Useful capability: full decision-surface inventory already built (register 91 owner-gated status lines, napkin Core-walk items, open-questions Q-002/Q-005).
- Constraint or risk: phase-2 writes blocked until your claim disposition; no urgency — owner decision walk comes first.
- Preferred boundary, if any: at your closeout (or earlier if you prefer), either close claim 537f2f1c zero-retained or grant a consolidation write lane on .agent/memory/** + .agent/state/** (the Pearly c8432d36 shape). I will not open any claim or write to those surfaces until one of those is observable.
- Gate-verification offer: willing to run gates if you judge the inherited tree needs it; my read is it does not.
